name: AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
Aicoso Wishlist enhances your WooCommerce store by allowing customers to save products for later, share wishlists, and receive personalized recommendations. Built with performance and user experience in mind, it seamlessly integrates with your existing WooCommerce setup.

Key Features

  • Add to Wishlist – One-click product saving with AJAX support
  • Guest Support – Allow non-registered users to create wishlists
  • Multiple Wishlists – Users can organize products into different lists
  • Wishlist Sharing – Share wishlists via social media or direct link
  • Product Variations – Full support for variable products
  • Quick Actions – Add to cart directly from wishlist
  • Responsive Design – Mobile-optimized interface
  • Analytics Dashboard – Track wishlist metrics and popular products
  • Price Drop Alerts – Notify users when wishlist items go on sale
  • Email Campaigns – Automated wishlist reminder emails
  • WooCommerce Blocks – Compatible with block-based checkout
  • Multi-language Ready – Translation ready with .pot file included

Perfect For

  • Fashion and apparel stores
  • Electronics and gadget shops
  • Home decor and furniture stores
  • Gift shops and boutiques
  • Any WooCommerce store looking to increase customer engagement

Support

For support, please visit https://aicoso.com/support

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores user wishlist data in your WordPress database. For guest users, temporary session data is stored using cookies. No data is sent to external servers except when using social sharing features (at user’s discretion).
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Aicoso Wishlist”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Via FTP

  1. Extract the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the aicoso-wishlist-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with my theme?

Yes! The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce.

Can guest users create wishlists?

Yes, guest users can create and manage wishlists. These are stored in browser sessions and can be converted to permanent wishlists when they register.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce blocks?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce block-based checkout and cart.

Can users create multiple wishlists?

Yes, registered users can create and manage multiple wishlists with different names and privacy settings.

Does it support variable products?

Yes, the plugin fully supports variable products and their variations.

How do I customize the wishlist button position?

Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Wishlist and choose your preferred button position from the available options.

Can I customize the email templates?

Yes, you can customize email templates through the plugin settings or by overriding them in your theme.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin respects user privacy and provides options for data management in compliance with GDPR.
